what: Boot menu brand (the name above the menu)
netbsd: n/a: boot.cfg has no image keyword; see netbsd-boot-banner
openbsd: n/a: boot(8) has no logo, banner or splash facility
dragonfly: n/a: dloader has no brand file; see loader-menu-title
illumos: /boot/forth/brand-<slug>.4th + /boot/<slug>-brand.png; loader_brand="<slug>"
size_format: PNG 400x100, 8-bit RGBA, drawn 7 text rows high; ASCII rows on a text console
notes: FreeBSD 14+ gfx-<name>.lua format; brand-<name>.lua is a legacy fallback

what: Boot menu logo (beside the menu)
netbsd: n/a: boot.cfg has no image keyword
openbsd: n/a: boot(8) has no logo facility
dragonfly: n/a: the ASCII mascot is compiled into dloader; fred_disable="YES" hides it
illumos: /boot/forth/logo-<slug>.4th + /boot/<slug>-logo.png; loader_logo="<slug>"
size_format: PNG 240x200, 8-bit RGBA, drawn 15 text rows high; ASCII rows on a text console
notes: illumos stock logo PNG is 236x126; check the aspect on an illumos framebuffer

what: Boot menu title and entries
illumos: check: whether the Forth menu reads a title variable
notes: DragonFly: copy /boot/defaults/dloader.menu and change only the titles

what: Boot banner lines and menu entries
illumos: n/a: see loader-menu-title
notes: replaces the stock welcome text

what: Splash while the kernel boots
netbsd: n/a: needs a kernel with options SPLASHSCREEN (not in GENERIC); boot(8) has a splash command for such kernels
illumos: check: no splash variable found in loader.conf(5)
size_format: PNG 1024x768, 8-bit RGBA, not interlaced (vt(4) draws only RGBA)
notes: boot_mute hides kernel messages; splash/ sizes are for live media and installers

dragonfly: /etc/motd (line 1 is updated only if it starts with DragonFly)

notes: starts with a blank line so the system line stays separate
